panel.title: Light curve
panel.footnote: Each exposure sees the object at a different wavelength, so each measurement is compared only with those of its own spectral channel ({{channels}} per band). A value of 1 is the typical brightness over the observed period.
panel.controlNote: Minimum error, measured on a star that does not vary ({{control}}): {{floor}} per pass.

relative.wings: Measured on the wings of the saturated source, in a ring from {{inner}} to {{outer}} around the core. It does not give the absolute brightness: only how much it changes.
relative.aperture: Brightness relative to the median of this band, which is {{reference}} mJy.

verdict.variable: It varies: the brightest and the faintest pass differ by {{amplitude}}, {{significance}} times the error.
verdict.marginal: Doubtful variation: passes differ by {{amplitude}}, {{significance}} times the error.
verdict.constant: No detectable variation: the difference between passes ({{amplitude}}) is under three times its error ({{error}}).

reason.unstable: The wings are not usable in this band: measurements from neighbouring days and the same channel differ by {{scatter}}, far more than the noise. No curve is shown because it would mean nothing.
reason.blended: Another source is inside the aperture: the measured light is offset {{offset}} from the object. A change in brightness would be that of the blend, not of the object.
reason.insufficient: Not enough measurements: {{n}} of {{total}} exposures gave a value, and two passes with at least three measurements each are needed.

chart.label: Light curve of {{name}} in {{band}}: relative brightness against date, over {{epochs}} passes. {{points}} measurements.
chart.hint: Move the pointer over the chart, or use the arrow keys, to read a value.
chart.legendBinned: Median over a few days, with its error

notice.saturated: Saturated source in {{bands}}: brightness is measured there on the wings, outside the core, and only gives relative variation.
notice.unstable: In {{bands}} the wings are not usable: neighbouring measurements of the same channel differ by up to {{scatter}}. No curve is shown in those bands.
notice.unvalidated: In {{bands}} the control star did not validate the wings (it scatters too much there itself). The curve passes the internal check, but has less support.
notice.offset: In {{bands}} another source is inside the aperture (light offset {{offset}}). There is no curve there, and no variation is claimed in the other bands because the blend can change between passes.
